pages.text: $(thing)Starlight Crafting Altar/$ is a crafting recipe type that uses the $(item)Starlight Package Crafting Altar/$ to craft recipes craftable in a Starlight Crafting Altar.

pages.title: Usage
pages.text: To use the $(item)Starlight Package Crafting Altar/$, you must build the Starlight Crafting Altar structure around it, shown on the next page.$(p)The crafter requires power and starlight.

pages.title: Usage (cont.)
pages.text: Items crafted by the $(item)Starlight Package Crafting Altar/$ will be ejected into adjacent inventories.

pages.title: AE2 Integration
pages.text: The $(item)Starlight Package Crafting Altar/$ can be connected to an $(thing)ME Network/$.$(p)It will extract power to use, and instead eject crafted items into the network.
